\begin{matlabcode}
function hw3_q4()

close all; clc;

%% (a)
fprintf('==== (a) clear_table.txt: linear regression fit (c = -1) ====\n');
data = load('clear_table.txt');
[a,b,d,meanDist] = fitPlaneLR_and_plot_xz(data, 'clear_table.txt (linear regression)', true);
fprintf('Plane (a):  z = %.6f x + %.6f y + %.6f\n', a, b, d);
fprintf('Mean orthogonal distance (m): %.6f\n\n', meanDist);

%% (b)
fprintf('==== (b) cluttered_table.txt: same linear regression fit (no outlier handling) ====\n');
data = load('cluttered_table.txt');
[a_b,b_b,d_b,meanDist_b] = fitPlaneLR_and_plot_xz(data, 'cluttered_table.txt (linear regression)', true);
fprintf('Plane (b):  z = %.6f x + %.6f y + %.6f\n', a_b, b_b, d_b);
fprintf('Mean orthogonal distance (m): %.6f\n', meanDist_b);
fprintf('Observation: Fit is skewed by clutter/outliers (e.g., cat). A robust method is needed.\n\n');

%% (c)
fprintf('==== (c) cluttered_table.txt: robust plane via RANSAC ====\n');
maxIters   = 2000;
inlierTol  = 0.01;
minInliers = 0.5;
plotGrid   = true;

[plane_c, inlierMask_c, stats_c] = ransacPlane(data, maxIters, inlierTol, minInliers);
plotPlaneOnCloud_xz(data, plane_c, inlierMask_c, 'cluttered_table.txt (RANSAC dominant plane)', plotGrid);
fprintf('RANSAC plane (c):  ax + by - z + d = 0  ->  z = %.6f x + %.6f y + %.6f\n', plane_c(1), plane_c(2), plane_c(4));
fprintf('Inliers: %d / %d   |   Robust mean dist (inliers): %.6f m\n\n', stats_c.numInliers, stats_c.N, stats_c.inlierMeanDist);

%% (d)
fprintf('==== (d) clean_hallway.txt: extract four planes via iterative RANSAC ====\n');
hall = load('clean_hallway.txt');
kPlanes = 4;
colors = lines(kPlanes);
figure('Name','clean_hallway: four planes (x–z base)');
hold on; grid on; axis equal; view(3);
title('clean_hallway: four dominant planes (x–z base, y vertical)', 'Interpreter','none');
xlabel('x [m]'); ylabel('z [m]'); zlabel('y [m]');
scatter3(hall(:,1), hall(:,3), hall(:,2), 4, [0.5 0.5 0.5], 'filled');

remainingMask = true(size(hall,1),1);
for k = 1:kPlanes
    [pl, inMask, st] = ransacPlane(hall(remainingMask,:), maxIters, inlierTol, 0.1);
    idxRem = find(remainingMask);
    sel = idxRem(inMask);
    plotPlaneOnCloud_xz(hall, pl, inMask, sprintf('Plane %d',k), false, colors(k,:));
    fprintf('Plane %d (d): z = %.6f x + %.6f y + %.6f  | inliers = %d   meanDist = %.6f m\n', ...
        k, pl(1), pl(2), pl(4), st.numInliers, st.inlierMeanDist);
    remainingMask(sel) = false;
end
lock_axes_xzy(hall); drawnow;

%% (e)
fprintf('==== (e) cluttered_hallway.txt: four wall planes + smoothness & safest surface ====\n');
hall2 = load('cluttered_hallway.txt');
inlierTol_e = 0.008; kPlanes_e = 4;
residualMask = true(size(hall2,1),1);
colors = lines(kPlanes_e);
scores = zeros(kPlanes_e,1);
figure('Name','cluttered_hallway: four planes & smoothness (x–z base)');
hold on; grid on; axis equal; view(3);
title('cluttered_hallway: four planes with smoothness scores (x–z base)', 'Interpreter','none');
xlabel('x [m]'); ylabel('z [m]'); zlabel('y [m]');
scatter3(hall2(:,1), hall2(:,3), hall2(:,2), 4, [0.7 0.7 0.7], 'filled');

for k = 1:kPlanes_e
    [pl, inMask, st] = ransacPlane(hall2(residualMask,:), maxIters, inlierTol_e, 0.05);
    idxRem = find(residualMask); sel = idxRem(inMask);
    dists = pointPlaneDistance(hall2(sel,:), pl);
    med = median(dists);
    scores(k) = sqrt(mean((dists - med).^2));
    plotPlaneOnCloud_xz(hall2, pl, inMask, sprintf('Plane %d (score=%.4g)', k, scores(k)), false, colors(k,:));
    fprintf('Plane %d (e): z = %.6f x + %.6f y + %.6f | smoothness=%.6g\n', k, pl(1), pl(2), pl(4), scores(k));
    residualMask(sel) = false;
end
[bestScore,bestIdx] = min(scores);
fprintf('\nSafest surface (smoothest) is Plane %d with score %.6g.\n', bestIdx, bestScore);
title(sprintf('cluttered_hallway: safest = Plane %d, score=%.3g', bestIdx, bestScore), 'Interpreter','none');
lock_axes_xzy(hall2); drawnow;

end

%% ---------------- Helper functions ----------------

function [a,b,d,meanDist] = fitPlaneLR_and_plot_xz(data, figTitle, doPlot)
x=data(:,1); y=data(:,2); z=data(:,3);
A=[x,y,ones(size(x))]; theta=A\z;
a=theta(1); b=theta(2); d=theta(3);
plane=[a,b,-1,d];
dist=pointPlaneDistance(data,plane);
meanDist=mean(dist);

if doPlot
    figure('Name',figTitle); hold on; grid on; axis equal; view(3);
    title([figTitle ' (x–z base, y vertical)'], 'Interpreter','none');
    xlabel('x [m]'); ylabel('z [m]'); zlabel('y [m]');
    scatter3(x,z,y,8,'b','filled');
    draw_plane_xz(plane,x,z,y,'FaceAlpha',0.35,'EdgeColor','none');
    lock_axes_xzy(data);
    txt=sprintf('z = %.3f x + %.3f y + %.3f\nMean dist = %.4f m',a,b,d,meanDist);
    text(min(x),min(z),max(y),txt,'Interpreter','none','BackgroundColor','w');
end
end

function d=pointPlaneDistance(P,plane)
a=plane(1); b=plane(2); c=-1; d0=plane(4);
num=abs(a*P(:,1)+b*P(:,2)+c*P(:,3)+d0);
den=sqrt(a^2+b^2+c^2);
d=num/den;
end

function [plane,inlierMask,stats]=ransacPlane(P,maxIters,inlierTol,minInlierFrac)
N=size(P,1); bestInliers=[]; bestPlane=[0 0 -1 0];
minInliersCount=max(3,ceil(minInlierFrac*N));
for it=1:maxIters
    idx=randperm(N,3); pts=P(idx,:);
    X=pts(:,1); Y=pts(:,2); Z=pts(:,3);
    M=[X,Y,ones(3,1)];
    if rank(M)<3, continue; end
    abdt=M\Z; a=abdt(1); b=abdt(2); d=abdt(3);
    pl=[a,b,-1,d];
    dists=pointPlaneDistance(P,pl);
    inliers=find(dists<=inlierTol);
    if numel(inliers)>numel(bestInliers)
        bestInliers=inliers(:); bestPlane=pl;
    end
end
if isempty(bestInliers)
    theta=[P(:,1),P(:,2),ones(N,1)]\P(:,3);
    plane=[theta(1),theta(2),-1,theta(3)];
    inlierMask=true(N,1);
else
    Xi=P(bestInliers,1); Yi=P(bestInliers,2); Zi=P(bestInliers,3);
    theta=[Xi,Yi,ones(numel(bestInliers),1)]\Zi;
    plane=[theta(1),theta(2),-1,theta(3)];
    dAll=pointPlaneDistance(P,plane);
    inlierMask=(dAll<=inlierTol);
end
dIn=pointPlaneDistance(P(inlierMask,:),plane);
stats.numInliers=sum(inlierMask); stats.N=N; stats.inlierMeanDist=mean(dIn);
end

function plotPlaneOnCloud_xz(P,plane,inlierMask,figTitle,makeNewFig,faceColor)
if nargin<5,makeNewFig=true;end
if nargin<6,faceColor=[1 0 0];end
x=P(:,1); y=P(:,2); z=P(:,3);
if makeNewFig
    figure('Name',figTitle); hold on; grid on; axis equal; view(3);
    title([figTitle ' (x–z base, y vertical)'], 'Interpreter','none');
    xlabel('x [m]'); ylabel('z [m]'); zlabel('y [m]');
end
scatter3(x(~inlierMask),z(~inlierMask),y(~inlierMask),4,[0.7 0.7 0.7],'filled');
scatter3(x(inlierMask),z(inlierMask),y(inlierMask),6,[0 0.4 1],'filled');
draw_plane_xz(plane,x,z,y,'FaceAlpha',0.25,'EdgeColor','none','FaceColor',faceColor);
lock_axes_xzy(P);
end

function draw_plane_xz(plane,x,z,y,varargin)
a=plane(1); b=plane(2); c=-1; d=plane(4);
if abs(b)>1e-6
    xr=linspace(min(x),max(x),30);
    zr=linspace(min(z),max(z),30);
    [X,Z]=meshgrid(xr,zr);
    Y=(Z - a*X - d)/b;
    lo=prctile(y,2); hi=prctile(y,98);
    Y=max(min(Y,hi),lo);
    surf(X,Z,Y,varargin{:});
else
    xr=linspace(min(x),max(x),30);
    yr=linspace(min(y),max(y),30);
    [X,Y]=meshgrid(xr,yr);
    Z=a*X + b*Y + d;
    surf(X,Z,Y,varargin{:});
end
end

function lock_axes_xzy(P)
x=P(:,1); y=P(:,2); z=P(:,3);
xlim([min(x) max(x)]); ylim([min(z) max(z)]); zlim([min(y) max(y)]);
pbaspect([1 1 1]);
end
